teks: If you counted one number every second without stopping, how long until you reach one billion?
Guess first! A, 1 year. B, 12 years. Or C, 31 years.
One number per second means you need 1 billion seconds.
So 1 billion divided by 86,400 gives 11,574 days, or about 31 years.
Counting to a million takes just 11.6 days. The answer is C, about 31 years without sleep!
